3. IRAN WAR: Iranian missiles fired at Aqaba intercepted by Israeli and Jordanian
   forces; Jordan reports downing three, a fourth fell in a deserted area.

4. IRAN WAR: Iran strikes US Gulf allies — Kuwait power-and-water plant ablaze for a

5. UK cost of living: Burnham inherits a slowing economy and energy bills already 13%
   higher since 1 July (cap £1,641 -> £1,862).

   wire scene-setter published today).
